introduction: HealthCare.gov helps people apply for Marketplace health coverage and find the enrollment route for their state. Enrollment timing and financial assistance depend on your circumstances.

who: Marketplace eligibility, financial assistance and any Special Enrollment Period are determined through the application. Your state may operate its own Marketplace.
sections.get: The application lets you explore health plans and potential financial assistance. Compare premiums, deductibles, prescription coverage and provider networks before selecting a plan.
sections.docs: Prepare household and income information and details of any current coverage. If using a Special Enrollment Period, follow requests for evidence of the qualifying event and its date.
sections.apply: Use HealthCare.gov’s application options to apply online or find phone, paper and assisted application routes. Check the current enrollment notice before relying on a deadline.
sections.after: Review eligibility results, complete any document request and select a plan when eligible. Confirm the insurer’s payment and start-date instructions. Keep Marketplace income estimates current when circumstances change.
sections.sources:
• HealthCare.gov application methods
  • HealthCare.gov enrollment dates
  • CMS March 2026 enrollment guidance
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Can I apply outside annual enrollment?
A qualifying Special Enrollment Period may allow enrollment. Check your circumstances with the Marketplace.
Is selecting a plan the same as making the first payment?
No. Follow the insurer’s instructions to complete enrollment and confirm coverage.
Can I get help completing an application?
Will every state use HealthCare.gov directly?
Some states operate their own Marketplace; follow the route for your state.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
blockers: Upcoming 2027 Marketplace closing date differs between HealthCare.gov summary and March 2026 CMS guidance; closing date intentionally omitted pending resolution.
